intro: Barbados is a coral limestone island, flatter than its volcanic neighbours.

chapters.title: Coasts and caves
text: The calm west coast has white beaches, while the wild east coast at Bathsheba faces Atlantic waves. Harrison's Cave is a limestone cave with streams and pools.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Barbados is sunny and warm, and lies just outside the main hurricane belt.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Barbados' landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
